summary: Ran auth/chat polling regression across backend APIs and frontend UI. Verified the 401-toast spam fix behavior: unauthenticated/public and post-logout sessions no longer show repeated auth toasts, while non-401 admin chat errors still surface as toasts.

minor.issue: CORS preflight with Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' even though allow-credentials headers are present; cookie-based same-origin app flow still works in preview.

integration_issues.issue: Console still logs repeated 401 network errors for /api/auth/me during unauthenticated states; no user-facing toast spam observed.

action_items: Investigate/fix CORS preflight origin matching for /api/auth/login OPTIONS (currently 400 Disallowed CORS origin for preview origin).
Optionally reduce expected unauthenticated /api/auth/me console error noise (keep UX silent as now).
After any CORS/auth middleware changes, rerun iteration20 backend and UI auth/chat regression.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is a very large monolith (>1800 lines), increasing auth/chat regression risk and review complexity.
Auth/session cookies are correctly HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None and password hash field is not exposed in auth responses.
Admin chat polling fix in frontend/src/components/LiveChat.jsx correctly suppresses toast only for 401 while preserving non-401 error toasts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested auth/chat UX checks in this run

seed_data_creation: Created transient test chat messages via customer and admin chat send actions during regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested auth flows passed (customer/admin login, /api/auth/me role checks, admin support chat load, logout behavior, lockout unchanged). Remaining known gap is explicit CORS preflight OPTIONS returning 400 for preview origin; same-origin browser session behavior remains functional.
rca of the issue: RCA: CORS preflight mismatch persists at /api/auth/login OPTIONS. Repro: send OPTIONS with Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com and Access-Control-Request-Method POST; response is 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' with allow-credentials headers. Potential mitigation: normalize/verify origin matching source for preview domain in middleware/ingress path and ensure exact runtime value alignment.
